subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and evidence handoff options
messages:
From: Lily Huang <lily.huang@acme-corp.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and audit period

Hi RoHan,

Thanks for the quick connect. Acme's vendor review flagged Redwood for a SOC 2 Type II package. Can you confirm the following?

1) Do you have an attested SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025?
2) If there are any timing gaps relative to our procurement deadline (12/10/2026), can you provide a bridge letter?
3) Preferred secure transfer methods (SFTP, presigned S3, secure Drive link) and whether you can provide an asset/control index (doc or CSV) that maps controls to artifacts.

Also, please share a minimal evidence list we can use to onboard our audit team (sample logs, retention statements, policy snapshots). If you already have templates or a short reply pack our procurement team can forward to engineering/legal, that would be great.

Thanks — we aim to close the compliance intake by 12/10.

Lily Huang
Security Program Manager
Acme Retail


From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Lily Huang <lily.huang@acme-corp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and audit period

Hi Lily — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front: yes, we have a Type II attestation for the period you listed; we can provide a bridge letter; and we support multiple secure transfer options. Below is a concise package and options so your procurement and audit teams know exactly what to expect.

What we can share immediately:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) for period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (redacted as needed)
- Bridge letter template (we'll tailor language after you confirm intake deadline)
- Asset/control index (CSV) that maps common controls to artifacts we can supply
- Evidence transfer playbook (short PDF) that outlines SFTP, presigned S3, or restricted Drive shares and our retention windows

Secure transfer options (pick one):
- SFTP to a customer-provisioned endpoint (preferred for large artifact sets)
- Time-limited presigned S3 URLs (we can generate per-file)
- Restricted Google Drive folder with viewer-only links + expiration

Minimal evidence examples we'll commit to provide on intake:
- Sample config screenshots (IAM, network controls)
- Policy PDFs (access control, incident response, change management)
- 7-day sample of audit logs (redacted where necessary) + description of retention policies
- Telemetry snapshot showing batching/cache behavior for inference (if requested)

I attached: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf (placeholder), bridge-letter-sample.docx, evidence-transfer-playbook.pdf, asset-index-ask.csv.

If you prefer, tell me which transfer method and we will create a HubSpot intake ticket and generate presigned links or SFTP details. I can also provide short one-line templates your procurement team can forward to engineering/legal — see bottom of this message.

One-line template (procurement -> engineering):
"Please provide the named artifact(s) from Redwood's asset-index-ask.csv; Redwood can deliver via presigned S3 or SFTP — reply to rohan_mehta@redwood.com to coordinate"

Let me know preferred transfer method and any timezone constraints; happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Ro Han Mehta
Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Lily Huang <lily.huang@acme-corp.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and audit period

RoHan — thanks, that is helpful. We'd prefer presigned S3 URLs for file-level access (audit team wants direct download links). A couple of clarifying asks:

- Does the SOC 2 report include the auditor's opinion page and the testing period summary?
- For the sample logs, can you confirm the retention policy (e.g., 90 days, 1 year) and whether logs include user-level activity for admin actions?
- For the bridge letter, can you advise whether you issue time-bound language (e.g., "no material changes since 12/31/2025") or more general attestation? Procurement will need to see the draft language to accept it.

If presigned S3 is fine we'll open the intake ticket and request links; please include per-file expiration (we usually ask for 7 days).

Lily

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Lily Huang <lily.huang@acme-corp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and audit period

Hi Lily — great, presigned S3 per-file links with 7-day expirations are fine. Answers to your clarifying questions and next steps below.

Audit coverage and report contents:
- Confirmation: the Type II report includes the auditor's opinion page and a testing summary that lists tested controls and sample sizes. Audit period covered: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

Sample logs and retention:
- Standard retention for system/audit logs is 365 days. For high-volume telemetry we retain 90 days by default; we can provide a 7-day sample extract for audit purposes. Logs include administrative action events (role changes, API key ops) with user/actor identifiers where available; PII is redacted in shared extracts.

Bridge letter language:
- We provide a short, time-bound bridge letter that affirms there were no material changes to our control environment between the end of the SOC period (12/31/2025) and the date of the letter. We can draft language for your legal/procurement review — sample attached (bridge-letter-sample.docx).

What we'll deliver when intake is opened:
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf (full report; redacted copies available on request)
- bridge-letter-sample.docx (editable) — we will finalize after we agree scope/language
- asset-index-ask.csv (map of controls -> artifacts and the filename we will upload)
- evidence-transfer-playbook.pdf (instructions for presigned S3 + security controls around links)

Next steps for Acme intake (proposed):
1) Confirm presigned S3 and intended recipients for access.
2) Acme opens the HubSpot intake ticket (or reply here) and we create the presigned links (7-day expiration).
3) We upload the files and email the links + a checksum manifest.

One-line reply templates for procurement and engineering (feel free to copy):
- Procurement -> Security: "Redwood can deliver the SOC 2 Type II report and named artifacts via presigned S3 links (7-day expiry). Please request files: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf; bridge-letter-draft; asset-index-ask.csv."
- Engineering -> Redwood: "Please upload the artifacts listed in asset-index-ask.csv using presigned S3 links; include redaction notes for any PII."

I will open the intake ticket on our side as well (HubSpot ticket created: 7654321). If you'd like a short 15-min sync to finalize the bridge wording, I can be available today 3–4pm PT.

Best regards,
Ro Han Mehta
Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
